introH2: 🏖️ How many kinds of budget stays does Cha-Am have, and how do you pick the right one?
introHtml: Cha-Am is a beach Bangkok folks can drive to in a day, and its charm is that you don't have to pay a lot to sleep near the sea — Cha-Am's budget stays come in more shapes than you'd think. Some are guesthouses a few steps from the beach that lean on location and a warm welcome; some are wood-house hostels with a seafront cafe on the ground floor; some are wood-bungalow resorts on a quiet lane with a garden pool; and some are boutique inns with teak-floored sea-view rooms where you wake up to the sea right in front of you. A common problem is people booking the lowest price and ending up with a windowless room, or hearing the bars at night and not sleeping. This article rounds up 10 budget-to-low-mid stays in Cha-Am we've reviewed in depth — along beachfront Ruamchit Road, the Bus Station soi, Narathip Road, and the Chao Lai soi. Every one comes from reading real guest reviews, telling you both the upsides and the honest caveats, comparing prices across 3 sites, and giving you direct booking links for all of them.
mrtHtml: Phetchaburi and Cha-Am have no train system — the easiest way to get around is to drive yourself. From Bangkok, take Phetkasem Road heading for Cha-Am, roughly 2.5–3 hours, and nearly all the budget stays in this article have free parking. By public transport, there are vans and coaches from Bangkok to Cha-Am, while the train stops at Cha-Am Railway Station, about 2–3 km from the beach area. The nearest airport is Hua Hin Airport (HHQ), about 16–21 km away. The stay areas in this article: Ruamchit Road — the main beachfront strip, walkable to the beach, with lots of seafood restaurants and bars. The Bus Station soi — a lane with several light-budget stays, a few minutes' walk to the beach. Narathip Road and the Chao Lai soi — a quieter area, good for travelers who want calm rest but still a short ride to the beach.

toc.name: The Beach Cha Am Guest House

entries.name: The Beach Cha Am Guest House
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Cha-Am Beach · Ruamchit Rd · ~100 m walk to the beach
entries.addr: 234/29-33 Bus Station Soi (Ruamchit Rd), Cha-Am Beach, Cha-Am Subdistrict, Cha-Am District
entries.storyHtml: If we start with the stay budget travelers to Cha-Am talk about most often, it has to be The Beach Cha Am Guest House. It's a mid-sized 2-star guesthouse in the Cha-Am Beach area, on the soi side near the bus station and Ruamchit Road, and what pushes it to the top is that it's about a 100 m walk down to Cha-Am Beach — wake up for a morning stroll by the sea or head out for a seafood dinner on the beach without calling a ride. What sets it apart from many small guesthouses is that it genuinely has rooms at several levels to match your budget, from a windowless Budget room of about 14 sqm for people who just need a bed, up to a Standard with a window, a Superior with a balcony, and a family room of about 30 sqm. Another point reviews agree on is that it has an in-house restaurant and cafe — in the morning there's breakfast (extra charge) to choose from, so you don't have to go far for food, plus a 24-hour counter that helps a lot for late arrivals, with free Wi-Fi and parking. From real reviews on Trip.com it scores 8.6 from 94 reviews, with location and cleanliness around 8.8; many praise the clean rooms, friendly staff, and value for a beachside location. Honest caveats from the reviews: rooms with a balcony facing the bar area may catch music at night, the cheapest Budget room has no window and feels cramped to some, the lighting in some rooms is fairly dim, bathroom amenities are basic with some reviews saying you only get soap, and there's no pool and no elevator — you take the stairs. In short, it's best for budget travelers, couples on a light budget, and small families who want to sleep near the beach at a reachable price. Pick the right room and set guesthouse-level expectations, and it offers standout value for a near-beach location in Cha-Am.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Don't just book the lowest price — the cheapest Budget room has no window. If you want natural light or a balcony, choose Standard or Superior. And if you're a light sleeper, ask for a room on the inner side or a quieter floor when you book, because the Cha-Am Beach area has nightlife bars.

Several room types to choose from, from Budget up to a family room
In-house restaurant and cafe, 24-hour counter, free parking
Clean rooms, friendly staff, good value for a beachside location (from reviews)
cons: Some balcony rooms catch music from nearby bars at night
The cheapest Budget room has no window · lighting in some rooms is dim

entries.name: Srisawat Resort Cha-Am
entries.badge: 🌿 Wood bungalows around a pool · quiet soi
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Narathip Rd · Cha-Am · ~500 m walk to the beach
entries.addr: 267/5 Narathip Rd, Cha-Am Subdistrict, Cha-Am District
entries.storyHtml: If you're tired of crowded beachfront-strip stays, Srisawat Resort is the opposite answer — a small resort of just 31 rooms in a Thai-Lanna wood-bungalow style, built as teak houses around a garden pool, on a dead-end soi off Narathip Road with no through traffic. Its selling point in the eyes of real guests is an atmosphere that's calm, leafy, and private — quiet enough that many say it feels like staying at a garden home, yet it's about a 500 m walk to Cha-Am Beach, with a 7-Eleven and Makro within walking distance. The heart of the resort is the outdoor garden pool — not huge, but shaded and uncrowded since there aren't many guests, with a separate kids' pool for families. Rooms come at several levels, from a compact Standard Double of 14 sqm, up to a much roomier Standard Twin of 27 sqm, to the Srisawat Thai Lanna Room of 30 sqm decorated in Lanna woodwork for a northern Thai-house feel. From real reviews, it scores 8.7 from 59 reviews on Trip.com — cleanliness high at around 9.1 and location around 9.0 — and about 4.0 of 5 stars on Tripadvisor; people praise the quiet, the pretty garden, the clean pool, and staff as friendly as visiting relatives. Honest caveats from the reviews: it's a wood building where the soundproofing between rooms isn't complete, so a loud conversation next door carries a bit; the 14 sqm Standard Double is fairly small with limited storage; most room rates don't include breakfast; there's no in-room safe; there's a key-card deposit of about 200 baht refunded at checkout; and some staff speak limited English. It's best for couples and families who want a small, quiet garden resort with a pool for the kids, within walking distance of the beach, at a reachable price. Choose a roomier room and set expectations to the price level, and many guests come away saying it's better value than expected.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If you're a group or have big luggage, skip the 14 sqm Standard Double and choose the roomier Standard Twin or Thai Lanna. Have about 200 baht cash ready for the key-card deposit, refunded at checkout. And since most rates don't include breakfast, it helps that 7-Eleven and restaurants are very close.

Garden pool and kids' pool, clean and uncrowded
About a 500 m walk to Cha-Am Beach, near 7-Eleven and Makro
Friendly staff, free parking, security on site, good value especially on weekdays
cons: Wood building with incomplete soundproofing between rooms, you hear the room next door a bit
The 14 sqm Standard Double is fairly small with limited storage
Most rates don't include breakfast · no safe · key-card deposit of ~200 baht

entries.name: The Beach Cha Am Residence
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Cha-Am beachfront · a few steps to the beach
tags: 🏖️ A few steps to the beach
💗 Owner cares for you like family
entries.addr: 234/35-37 Bus Station Soi, Cha-Am Subdistrict, Cha-Am District
entries.storyHtml: The name is close to the first place on this list, but The Beach Cha Am Residence is a different place with its own personality — a small beachfront guesthouse/residence in the Bus Station soi, next to the beachfront-strip zone, that real guests talk about most for its location and warm service. The point mentioned most consistently is the beachfront location, a few steps to the sea — wake up and walk straight to the water — and service that's friendlier than the price, with the owner and staff looking after you closely. One review describes how, when a family guest had a health emergency, the team helped take them to the hospital and stayed for hours to translate, which is rare at this price. Another thing that sets it apart is that it's pet-friendly (with a fee), a rare option in this area for people bringing a dog or cat to the seaside. There's a beachfront restaurant, The Beach Restaurant, where you can dine looking at the sea, fresh homemade breakfast, free private parking, and a 24-hour front desk. Rooms come in several types, from a windowless Budget of about 11–12 sqm up to a Superior with a balcony/terrace and a 30 sqm family room. From real reviews, Trip.com 8.1 from 150 reviews and TripAdvisor around 4.4 of 5, ranked #2 of 65 guesthouses in Cha-Am — high for a small place. Honest caveats from the reviews: the soi has shops and bars, so on weekends you may hear music in rooms facing the road; the building is old with no elevator and steep stairs; some "sea view" rooms require leaning off the balcony to see the sea; and a few reviews fault bathroom cleanliness or water pressure in some rooms. It's best for couples, solo travelers, road-trippers, and people bringing a pet who want to sleep near the sea at a budget price and value warm service over luxury.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If you're with elderly travelers or have heavy luggage, ask for a ground-floor room when you book, because the building has no elevator and steep stairs. Don't expect full sea-view rooms — this place sells its walk-to-the-beach location. And if you're bringing a pet, notify them in advance and ask about the fee clearly.

entries.mrtTag: 📍 Cha-Am Beach · Ruamchit Rd · ~1 min across the road

rooms.type: Bed in a shared dorm (shared bathroom)

tags: 🏖️ On the beach, ~1 min across the road
entries.addr: 234/4 Ruamchit Rd, Cha-Am Beach, Cha-Am Subdistrict, Cha-Am District
entries.storyHtml: If you want to sleep right by Cha-Am Beach on a few-hundred-to-low-thousand budget and wake up sipping coffee with a sea view, Banmai Cha-am Hostel is a name backpackers mention often. It's a small 2-star hostel of about 9 rooms on Ruamchit Road by Cha-Am Beach, with a Thai-Western wood-house design that's warm and photogenic. What sets it apart from a typical hostel is that it has the Banmai cafe on the seafront ground floor, open to outside visitors too; many reviews praise the coffee and cappuccino, with some saying it's as good as the best they've tried in Cha-Am. The location is also a strength, since it's about a 1-minute walk across the road to the beach, with seafood restaurants, convenience stores, and bike rentals nearby. Rooms come in several types, from a bed in a shared dorm where each bed has a reading light, power outlet, and personal locker, up to a small private room, a family room, and a private sea-view room with a queen bed, some with a balcony facing the beach. Every room is air-conditioned with a fridge, flat-screen TV, and hot water. From real reviews, around 8.6 and TripAdvisor around 4 of 5; people praise the on-the-beach location, the good cafe coffee, the warm wood-house design, clean rooms with comfortable beds, and friendly staff. Honest caveats from the reviews: the cheapest dorm uses a shared bathroom, so people who don't read the details may feel it's not what they expected; there's no pool and no hotel-style breakfast; cafe service can slow down and some items run out when it's busy; it's a small wood building so you hear between rooms a bit; and Cha-Am Beach here is a town beach that gets crowded on holidays. It's best for budget travelers, couples, groups of friends, and cafe lovers who want to sleep on the beach on a light budget and enjoy a wood-house feel. If you're fine with hostel conditions and pick the right room, it offers standout value for a beachfront location in Cha-Am.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Read the room types carefully — if you want a private bathroom, choose a private room, family room, or sea-view room; don't just book the lowest price, because that's the shared-bathroom dorm. If you want to wake up to the sea, specify a Seaview room when you book, as they're limited. And go down and try the coffee at the ground-floor cafe.

In-house Banmai cafe with good coffee, sit and watch the sea
Warm wood-house design, clean rooms, comfortable beds

entries.name: Pa Sabai Resort Cha Am
entries.revCount: Small guesthouse ~7 rooms · real reviews praise the host highly
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Chao Lai 2 Soi · Cha-Am · short ride to the beach
tags: 🏡 Owner Patty runs it herself, good English
entries.addr: 304/19 Chao Lai 2 Soi, Chao Lai Rd, Cha-Am Subdistrict, Cha-Am District
entries.storyHtml: If you're tired of big buildings and crowds and want a quiet corner with someone looking after you like a friend's home, Pa Sabai Resort Cha Am is a name that comes up often in reviews. It's a small guesthouse of about 7 rooms on Chao Lai 2 Soi, about 1 km from central Cha-Am, and a short ride of about 6 minutes to Cha-Am Beach. What people mention most isn't a fancy pool or a grand lobby, but the owner, named Patty, who looks after guests herself, speaks good English, and makes it feel like coming home — international reviews say they felt at home and were well cared for, with the host recommending all the places to eat and visit. Rooms are air-conditioned, roomier than expected and very clean per the reviews, with a fridge, TV with international channels, a private bathroom with hot water, and many have a private balcony/sitting terrace. Another charm is the shared space with a shared kitchen to cook your own food, a BBQ grill, a picnic area, bikes to borrow, and an EV charger that fits this era when many drive an EV to the seaside. It's about 500 m from the Cha-Am viewpoint, with a bus stop near the stay. From real reviews, it earns very high praise for the host, cleanliness, and quiet — though the review base isn't as large as a big hotel, so read it as an overall quality picture. Honest caveats from the reviews: it's a small guesthouse with no pool and no breakfast; the water heater in some rooms can't adjust temperature, only full-hot or off; there are small worn spots like a towel rail; it's not right on the beach, so you take a short ride or bike to the beach; and there are no extra beds/cribs and no pets. It's best for couples and travelers who want a quiet corner near the beach at a budget price, with host-style care. If you understand the warm-home concept from the start, it offers standout value on a sub-thousand budget.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: It's an owner-run stay, so giving your arrival time in advance via the booking channel or phone helps check-in go smoothly. There's no breakfast but there's a shared kitchen and BBQ grill — stop by a fresh market or convenience store before you arrive to make the most of the kitchen. And borrow a bike to ride to the beach easily.

entries.name: Evergreen Resort Cha-am
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Cha-Am · Rat Phli 2 Rd · ~900 m from the beach
tags: 🏖️ ~900 m walk to the beach (~4 min)
entries.addr: 255/24 Rat Phli 2 Rd, Cha-Am Subdistrict, Cha-Am District
entries.storyHtml: We'll include a stay where the reviews clearly split two ways, for the sake of honesty — Evergreen Resort Cha-am is a small 3-star resort, a building of about 3–4 floors with around 15 rooms, on Rat Phli 2 Road in the Cha-Am area, about 900 m from the beach, roughly a 4-minute walk. What makes people choose it is that it offers an outdoor pool and free parking at guesthouse-level prices, which is rare in the budget group; the rooms are fairly roomy and bright, some with a double balcony, and there's an elevator too. The people who stay and are okay with it tend to be mid-budget couples, small families driving in, and those who use it as a base to be out all day and come back to sleep. But to be honest, the scores reflect the limits — Agoda is around 6.7 from 442 reviews, Traveloka around 7.5, Trip.com around 7.6, while Booking and Tripadvisor sit mid-to-lower. Honest caveats from the reviews: the most-mentioned issue is that the room walls are fairly thin, so you hear neighboring rooms and the corridor — the number-one complaint; next is that the building and rooms are aging with inconsistent upkeep; the pool condition is sometimes not well maintained; the Western breakfast is inconsistent in quality and many rates charge an extra ~120 baht per person; and some reviews feel the reality doesn't match the promotional photos. It's best for budget travelers in Cha-Am who want a walk-to-the-beach location, a pool for the kids, and free parking, prioritizing price and location over newness and quiet. Check the latest review photos and inspect the room at check-in, and you'll be less likely to be disappointed.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Thin walls and noise are the number-one complaint. If you're a light sleeper, ask for a top-floor or corner room away from the corridor, and bring earplugs just in case. Many rates charge an extra ~120 baht per person for breakfast — check clearly when you book. And look at photos from the latest reviews and inspect the room at check-in; if it's not okay, ask to change right away.

entries.name: Cha Inn @ Cha-am
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Cha-Am beachfront · Ruamchit Rd · cross the road to the beach
tags: ☕ Cafe and Thai restaurant on the ground floor
🏖️ Cross the road to the beach
entries.addr: 274/34 Ruamchit Rd, Cha-Am Subdistrict, Cha-Am District
entries.storyHtml: If you're tired of tall hotels with lots of rooms and want a small beachfront boutique feel, Cha Inn @ Cha-am fits well. At a glance the building looks more like a seafront cafe than a hotel — the ground floor is an open-air restaurant and cafe, while the upper floor hides just 17 rooms, set on Ruamchit Road across from Cha-Am Beach. The highest-scoring point is location: the location category on booking platforms is around 9.1 of 10, because you cross the road and reach the sand and sea in a few steps, surrounded by seafood restaurants and convenience stores. The star of the show is the Sea View rooms with teak floors that use tall glass opening onto a private balcony facing the beach — wake up to the sea in front of you, plus teak floors that feel warm and clean. Another strength is the ground-floor Thai restaurant that reviews praise for freshness, sometimes making off-menu dishes, with good-value cocktails to sip in the evening looking at the sea. From real reviews, the average across several platforms is around 8.1 of 10, staff 8.7 and cleanliness 8.4; people mainly praise the cleanliness, the quiet, and attentive staff. Honest caveats from the reviews: the building has no elevator, so you walk up wooden stairs to the upper-floor rooms; there's no in-house pool; some bathrooms are partitioned with wooden slats and a glass door, which looks pretty but doesn't fully contain sound or privacy; breakfast is a light continental; and parking is limited. It's best for couples and travelers who want a small, quiet beachfront boutique inn at a reachable price, with sea-view rooms and close-up care. If you value atmosphere and location over amenities, it's better value than the price.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: The whole inn has just 17 rooms and not every room sees the sea. If the view matters, specify a Sea View room when you book, as they're very limited. The building has no elevator, so anyone with heavy luggage or trouble with stairs should ask for a ground-floor room. And don't forget to try the Thai food at the ground-floor restaurant.

entries.name: Nirundorn Resort Chaam
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Cha-Am Beach · Ruamchit Rd · cross the road to the beach
tags: 🏖️ Cross the road to the beach · next to 7-Eleven
entries.addr: 247/7 Ruamchit Rd, Cha-Am Beach, Cha-Am Subdistrict, Cha-Am District
entries.storyHtml: Another budget beachfront resort where the reviews split two ways and your experience depends on the room you get — Nirundorn Resort Chaam is a 3-star resort on Ruamchit Road, right across from Cha-Am Beach, with about 55 rooms. The main selling point is that you cross the road and you're at the beach, and it's next to a 7-Eleven — want water or a snack and you walk right out to buy it; nearby are restaurants, seafood spots, and the Cha-Am night market within a walk or short drive. Another highlight is the outdoor saltwater pool, gentler on skin and eyes than a chlorine pool, with a separate kids' pool, cleaned every morning, good for families. It has the SHA Plus+ standard and renovated part of its rooms in 2021, so the updated rooms look fresher and cleaner than many expect, plus free private parking. From real reviews, Trip.com 7.8 from 25 reviews, location around 7.9 and cleanliness around 7.8; the fans say the renovated rooms are roomy, clean, and pleasant, the pool is good, and the price is low for a beachfront location. Honest caveats from the reviews: the most-mentioned issue is that room condition and cleanliness are inconsistent — some reviews find small rooms, a musty or drain smell in some rooms, and uneven upkeep across rooms; next is noise, since the Ruamchit Road area has restaurants and speakers playing music late on some nights; and a few mention unexpected extra charges. It's best for budget couples, families, and groups of friends who want a beachfront stay at a light price and use the resort as a base for walking around. Choose a renovated room and set expectations to the price, and it offers value on a location that's hard to find at this price.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Room condition here differs clearly between old and new rooms. Note at booking or check-in that you want a room renovated 2021 or later to reduce the chance of getting an old or musty room. If you're a light sleeper, ask for an inner room away from the road and restaurants. And ask about room rates, deposit, and conditions clearly at check-in to avoid misunderstandings.

Budget price compared with beachfront stays in the area (from reviews)

entries.storyHtml: If you want to visit Cha-Am with a pool to dip in and a walk to the beach, but don't want to pay full beachfront-resort prices, Cha Am My House is a name budget travelers to Cha-Am mention often. It's a 2-star resort of about 43 rooms in the Cha-Am Beach area, on the Bus Station soi off Ruamchit Road, open since 2017. The clearest thing that sets it apart from typical light-budget guesthouses on the same soi is that it has an outdoor pool, an elevator, and free parking in two spots at guesthouse-level prices, which isn't common. The star is the pool with sun loungers that many reviews say is genuinely usable and prettier than expected, where kids can swim without going to the beach every time. Rooms come in several types, from a windowless Budget of about 14 sqm, up to a Standard with a window or pool view, a Superior with a balcony/pool view, a Superior Pool Access where you step straight to the pool from the room, and up to Triple and Family Rooms. There's an in-house restaurant and bar, several breakfast options included, and a 24-hour counter, and it's pet-friendly (extra charge). From real reviews, Trip.com 8.5 from 181 reviews, location around 8.8, service around 8.7, cleanliness around 8.6; people praise the pool, the near-beach location, cleanliness, friendly staff, and value. Honest caveats from the reviews: the resort has been open since 2017, so some rooms and fixtures like the shower or TV are older models and some reviews say it feels a bit dated; the Cha-Am Beach area has nearby bars and some rooms have poor soundproofing; the cheapest Budget room has no window; sometimes the room you get doesn't match what you booked; and it's not right on the beach so there are no sea-view rooms. It's best for budget travelers, couples, groups of friends, and families who want to sleep near the beach on a light budget but still want a pool and an elevator for convenience. Pick the right room for your needs, and it offers standout value for a near-beach location in Cha-Am.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: The pool is the highlight. If you want to step straight to the pool from your room, choose Superior Pool Access, or pick a pool-view room and specify it clearly when you book. Avoid the windowless Budget room if you want natural light. And there's a deposit of about 500 baht at check-in, refunded at checkout — have it ready.

entries.name: Cha-Am Fish Star
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Ruamchit Rd · Cha-Am · a few steps to the beach
tags: 🏖️ A few steps to the beach
🚲 Free bikes to borrow + free parking
📶 Strong Wi-Fi, clean rooms, cold A/C
entries.addr: 234/42 Ruamchit Rd, Cha-Am Subdistrict, Cha-Am District
entries.storyHtml: We close the list with the stay that has the lowest starting price in this set — Cha-Am Fish Star is a small guesthouse on Ruamchit Road in central Cha-Am that sells location and a warm welcome more than luxury, and it fits people who just want a clean room with cold A/C, a few steps out the door to the beach, and the leftover money for seafood. The thing real guests mention consistently is the location, a few steps to Cha-Am Beach by crossing the road, surrounded by restaurants, coffee shops, and convenience stores within a walk, with the Cha-Am viewpoint about 400 m away. Another point that gets special praise is the free bikes to borrow for riding along the beach and to the market, free parking, and Wi-Fi that many reviews praise as strong and stable. The owner and team run it themselves, warmly — some reviews say they welcome you genuinely like a guest at home, recommending restaurants and sights — with a 24-hour counter for late arrivals. Rooms are air-conditioned with a private bathroom, flat-screen TV, and fridge, with small welcome touches like water, tea, coffee, and biscuits. From real reviews, around 8.4 from over 630 reviews and TripAdvisor around 4.0 of 5; people praise the walk-to-the-beach location, cleanliness, the welcome, and value. Honest caveats from the reviews: rooms are small with limited storage, some have no wardrobe or drawers; some TVs only get Thai channels and have no HDMI port; some items like a hair dryer or iron may not be in the room; there's no pool and breakfast isn't included; and some rooms are windowless. It's best for couples, solo travelers, and budget travelers who want to stay by Cha-Am Beach, prioritizing clean rooms and a walk-to-everything location over a pool or a big room — good value that makes it clear why the review scores are solid.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Set expectations right — this is a small, budget guesthouse with no pool and no breakfast included. If you want a balcony or a room with a window, specify the room type clearly when you book, because some rooms have no window. If you need a hair dryer or iron, ask in advance or bring your own. And borrow the free bikes to make the most of getting around.

faqTitle: FAQ — questions travelers often ask about budget stays in Cha-Am, Phetchaburi

faq.q: ❓ Which is the best budget stay in Cha-Am?
faq.a: It depends on your trip style. If you measure by review scores and host-style care, Pa Sabai Resort Cha Am earns very high praise for the owner and cleanliness (small review base). If you want a balance of score and review count, Srisawat Resort at 8.7 and The Beach Cha Am Guest House and Banmai Cha-am Hostel at 8.6. If you want a pool and an elevator on a light budget, Cha Am My House at 8.5. If you want a sea-view room, Cha Inn @ Cha-am. And if you want the lowest starting price, Cha-Am Fish Star from ฿500.

faq.q: ❓ How much do budget stays in Cha-Am cost?
faq.a: In this article, prices start at about ฿500–900 per night. The cheapest starting prices are Cha-Am Fish Star ฿500, and The Beach Cha Am Residence and Banmai Cha-am Hostel ฿550. The ฿650–700 group includes The Beach Cha Am Guest House, Cha Am My House, Srisawat Resort, and Evergreen Resort. And the ฿800–900 group includes Cha Inn @ Cha-am, Pa Sabai Resort, and Nirundorn Resort. All prices are approximate starting prices from standard rooms; on long holidays and in high season, prices rise.

faq.q: ❓ Which budget stays in Cha-Am have a swimming pool?
faq.a: Several in this article. Cha Am My House ฿650 has a pool and an elevator at guesthouse prices. Srisawat Resort ฿700, a quiet garden pool with a kids' pool. Nirundorn Resort Chaam ฿900, a saltwater pool with a kids' pool. And Evergreen Resort Cha-am ฿700 has an outdoor pool (check updated photos first, as upkeep is inconsistent at times).

faq.q: ❓ Which stays in Cha-Am are within walking distance of the beach?
faq.a: The fastest walks to the beach are the beachfront Ruamchit Road group — Banmai Cha-am Hostel, Cha Inn @ Cha-am, Nirundorn Resort, and Cha-Am Fish Star, where you cross the road to the beach. The Beach Cha Am Guest House is about 100 m, and The Beach Cha Am Residence and Cha Am My House are a few minutes' walk. Meanwhile Srisawat Resort at about 500 m and Evergreen Resort at about 900 m are still walkable.

faq.q: ❓ Are there pet-friendly stays in Cha-Am?
faq.a: Yes. In this article, The Beach Cha Am Residence is one of the few stays in Cha-Am that welcomes pets (with a fee per pet per night), and Cha Am My House also welcomes pets (extra charge). For both, notify in advance and confirm the conditions with the stay clearly before booking.

faq.q: ❓ What should you know about nightlife bar noise in Cha-Am?
faq.a: The beachfront Ruamchit Road area and nearby sois have restaurants and bars that play music late on some nights, especially Friday–Saturday and during festivals. Several stays in this article — The Beach Cha Am Guest House, The Beach Cha Am Residence, Nirundorn Resort, Cha Am My House, and Evergreen Resort — have reviews mentioning this. If you're a light sleeper, we recommend you ask for a room on the inner side or a floor away from the bar area when you book, and pack earplugs just in case. If you want real quiet, choose Srisawat Resort or Pa Sabai Resort, which are on quieter sois.
